Approval of Minutes • March 7, 2023 Regular Meeting
Introduction of New or Unfinished Business by Board Members
All matters listed hereunder constitute a Consent Calendar
Approving various routine parking and traffic modifications
Approving 20th Street from Shotwell Street to Potrero Avenue as part of the Slow Streets Program to contribute to the citywide Program of low-stress routes
Presentation and discussion regarding a Racial Equity Action Plan update
Adopting the Visitacion Valley & Portola Community Based Transportation Plan
Adopting the Climate Roadmap for a Healthier San Francisco, a roadmap of priority actions for the SFMTA to help meet the City’s net-zero emissions goal by 2040 and mode share goal by 2030

Discussion and vote pursuant to Administrative Code Section 67.10(b) as to whether to meet in closed session to discuss public employee performance evaluations RECESS REGULAR MEETING AND CONVENE CLOSED SESSION
Pursuant to Government Code Section 54957(b) and Administrative Code Section 67.10(b), the SFMTA Board of Directors will meet in closed session to discuss PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
Motion to disclose or not disclose the information discussed in Closed Session
